# Organization Profile

## Identity

**Canonical public name:** **Gen3**. The organization also uses **Gen3 Labs**; its official portfolio site brands the group as “Gen3,” while Aigent.run’s legal terms identify **Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd.** as the product developer. [Gen3’s official site](https://gen3games.com/) and an [XRPL Commons interview](https://www.xrpl-commons.org/newsroom/gen3-labs-on-aigent-run-the-future-of-ai-agents-on-xrpl) connect Gen3 Labs to Aigent.run and its founders.

**Entity type:** A public-facing blockchain, gaming, and AI development organization formerly associated with a Singapore private limited company. Singapore’s official Gazette records **Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd.**, UEN 202451673Z, as struck off on 14 May 2026. [Singapore Government Gazette](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/277/227650f4-613d-43a6-8db4-b1eb07040261/Final%20Gazette%20COM%201%20May%20to%2015%20May%202026.pdf)

**Supported names:** Gen3; Gen3 Labs; Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd. A secondary company-record aggregator reports **Tradeverse Pte. Ltd.** as the former legal name attached to the same UEN, but this name history was not independently recoverable from the accessible ACRA interface and is therefore treated as provisional. [RecordOwl company record](https://recordowl.com/company/tradeverse-pte-ltd)

**Validator connection:** An XRPL explorer identifies the exact key `nHUinfdpmtfXsMUnoSoBeZ93mTwDkPkA2gmCiQTyEi1c1Ybx6unE` as “Gen3 Labs” and reports `gen3labs.xyz` as its TOML-verified domain. [Bithomp validator record](https://bithomp.com/validator/nHUinfdpmtfXsMUnoSoBeZ93mTwDkPkA2gmCiQTyEi1c1Ybx6unE) The organization’s public account separately describes Gen3 as maintaining XRPL infrastructure, corroborating the organizational connection, although X itself was not directly accessible during this research. [Public mirror of @Gen3Labs](https://mobile.twstalker.com/Gen3Labs)

## Official Web Presence

**Official website:** [https://gen3games.com/](https://gen3games.com/). It presents the Gen3 name, products, team, and partners; Gen3’s company-controlled LinkedIn profile also lists this website. [Gen3 LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/company/gen3labs)

**Validator identity domain:** `https://gen3labs.xyz`. Bithomp reports that its XRPL TOML associates the domain with the supplied validator key, but the website and TOML endpoint could not be accessed directly during this research. [Bithomp validator record](https://bithomp.com/validator/nHUinfdpmtfXsMUnoSoBeZ93mTwDkPkA2gmCiQTyEi1c1Ybx6unE)

**Official X handle:** [@Gen3Labs](https://x.com/Gen3Labs). The basis is an XRPL Commons article linking “Gen3 X” to that account and Gen3’s public communications mirrored elsewhere. The X page itself returned an access restriction and was not treated as directly browsed. [XRPL Commons](https://www.xrpl-commons.org/newsroom/gen3-labs-on-aigent-run-the-future-of-ai-agents-on-xrpl)

## Incorporation and Operations

**Incorporation jurisdiction:** **Singapore — high confidence for the former legal entity.** Aigent.run’s terms name Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd., while Singapore’s ACRA-issued Gazette identifies UEN 202451673Z and records the company’s strike-off on 14 May 2026. No currently active successor legal entity was established. [Aigent.run terms](https://aigent.run/en/terms) [Singapore Government Gazette](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/277/227650f4-613d-43a6-8db4-b1eb07040261/Final%20Gazette%20COM%201%20May%20to%2015%20May%202026.pdf)

**Principal operating regions:** **Not established — high confidence that the available evidence is insufficient.** Public materials show a distributed team and internet-delivered products, but do not establish a principal headquarters or operating base. Singapore incorporation, individual team locations, and validator-server metadata were not treated as proof of principal operations.

## Activities

Gen3 presents itself as a developer of gamified blockchain and AI products for the XRP Ledger and Root Network. Its published portfolio includes Zerpmon, a creature-collecting game; Tradeverse, a digital-collectibles marketplace; Aigent.run, an AI-agent launchpad and natural-language on-chain terminal; Axiom Protocol, a prediction market; and Project Loot, a game project. [Gen3 portfolio](https://gen3games.com/)

Aigent.run is described as supporting wallet interaction, token analysis, trading automation, blockchain exploration, portfolio tools, and XRPL transaction execution through conversational commands. Its users are principally XRP Ledger participants and digital-asset users. [Aigent.run](https://aigent.run/) [Aigent.run terms](https://aigent.run/en/terms)

The validator relationship is supported by the exact key-to-domain record and by Gen3’s public statements that it operates XRPL network infrastructure. [Bithomp validator record](https://bithomp.com/validator/nHUinfdpmtfXsMUnoSoBeZ93mTwDkPkA2gmCiQTyEi1c1Ybx6unE) A mirrored August 2026 account announcement says Aigent.run and Axiom Protocol were scheduled to wind down on 13 September 2026 while Gen3 continued its core XRPL infrastructure activity; direct verification of that post on X was unavailable. [Public mirror of @Gen3Labs](https://mobile.twstalker.com/Gen3Labs)

## Public Footprint

**Small (11–50) — medium confidence.** Gen3’s official site publicly names eleven core-team, developer, design, and art contributors and presents several products and ecosystem partnerships. [Gen3 team and portfolio](https://gen3games.com/) Its LinkedIn profile instead reports a 2–10 company-size band and three visible employees, so current headcount is **not established**. [Gen3 LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/company/gen3labs)

## Business Summary

Gen3 is a public-facing blockchain and artificial-intelligence development organization associated with the former Singapore company Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd., which was struck off the Singapore register on 14 May 2026. Its principal operating base is not established. The organization presents a portfolio centered on XRP Ledger and Root Network applications: Zerpmon, a creature-collecting game; Tradeverse, a digital-collectibles marketplace; Aigent.run, an AI-agent launchpad and natural-language on-chain terminal; Axiom Protocol, a prediction market; and network-infrastructure participation. Its users and stakeholders include blockchain gamers, digital-collectible traders, XRP Ledger users and developers, partner ecosystems, and online communities. The products are internet-delivered and ecosystem-oriented, but no reliable geographic operating region has been established. Its public footprint is Small: the official site names eleven team contributors and several products and partners, although verified current headcount is not established.

## Evidence

1. [Bithomp — “Gen3 Labs Validator”](https://bithomp.com/validator/nHUinfdpmtfXsMUnoSoBeZ93mTwDkPkA2gmCiQTyEi1c1Ybx6unE) — XRPL explorer; accessed 2026-09-03. Supports the exact validator key, “Gen3 Labs” identity, and TOML-verified `gen3labs.xyz` domain.
2. [Gen3 — “Leading Gamers Onchain”](https://gen3games.com/) — official organizational website; accessed 2026-09-03. Supports the Gen3 public name, product portfolio, activities, stakeholders, named team contributors, and partnerships.
3. [Aigent.run — “Terms of Use”](https://aigent.run/en/terms) — official legal page; accessed through indexed page content on 2026-09-03. Supports the name Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd., its role as Aigent.run’s developer, and the service description.
4. [Singapore Government Gazette — Final Gazette, 1–15 May 2026](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/277/227650f4-613d-43a6-8db4-b1eb07040261/Final%20Gazette%20COM%201%20May%20to%2015%20May%202026.pdf) — official Singapore government/ACRA publication; accessed 2026-09-03. Supports Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd., UEN 202451673Z, and its strike-off on 14 May 2026.
5. [XRPL Commons — “Gen3 Labs on Aigent.run & the Future of AI Agents on XRPL”](https://www.xrpl-commons.org/newsroom/gen3-labs-on-aigent-run-the-future-of-ai-agents-on-xrpl) — XRPL ecosystem organization interview; accessed 2026-09-03. Supports the founders’ identification of Gen3 Labs as Aigent.run’s parent, principal activities, and the link to @Gen3Labs.
6. [Aigent.run](https://aigent.run/) — official product website; accessed 2026-09-03. Supports Aigent.run’s XRPL-focused AI-terminal functions and intended user activities.
7. [Gen3 Labs LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/gen3labs) — company-controlled platform profile; accessed 2026-09-03. Supports consulting and product-development activities, the Gen3 website, a 2–10 size declaration, and three visible employees.
8. [RecordOwl — “Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd. / Tradeverse Pte. Ltd.”](https://recordowl.com/company/tradeverse-pte-ltd) — secondary Singapore company-data aggregator; accessed 2026-09-03. Supports the reported former legal name and UEN, subject to the limitations described above.
9. [Public mirror of @Gen3Labs](https://mobile.twstalker.com/Gen3Labs) — third-party mirror of public X content; accessed 2026-09-03. Supports recent public statements about XRPL infrastructure and planned product wind-down; direct X access was unavailable.

## Uncertainty

- The current legal vehicle behind the continuing Gen3 public brand and validator is **not established**. Gen3 Labs Pte. Ltd. was struck off Singapore’s register on 14 May 2026.
- `gen3labs.xyz` and its TOML endpoint were not directly accessible. The key-domain association relies on Bithomp’s explicit TOML-verification report.
- The reported former name **Tradeverse Pte. Ltd.** comes from secondary company-record aggregators rather than a directly accessible ACRA history extract; it is not treated as a general brand alias.
- Principal headquarters and operating regions are not established. Singapore incorporation, individual personnel locations, and infrastructure geography were excluded as proxies.
- Current headcount is not established: the official site names eleven contributors, while LinkedIn reports a 2–10 size band and three visible employees.
- Direct access to X was restricted. @Gen3Labs is supported by XRPL Commons’ outbound link and mirrored public content, but individual posts could not be checked on X itself.
- Public materials conflict on current product status: official websites continued presenting products, while a mirrored August 2026 announcement said Aigent.run and Axiom Protocol would close on 13 September 2026.
